verses.original: וְלִבְנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן מַחְלְקוֹתָ֑ם בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן נָדָב֙ וַאֲבִיה֔וּא אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְאִיתָמָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·liḇ·nê ’a·hă·rōn maḥ·lə·qō·w·ṯām bə·nê ’a·hă·rōn nā·ḏāḇ wa·’ă·ḇî·hū ’el·‘ā·zār wə·’î·ṯā·mār
verses.literal: These were the divisions of the descendants of Aaron The sons of Aaron were Nadab Abihu Eleazar and Ithamar
verses.literalPt: E QUANTO aos filhos de Arão, estas foram as suas divisões: os filhos de Arão: Nadabe, Abiú, Eleazar e Itamar.

verses.original: וַיָּ֨מָת נָדָ֤ב וַאֲבִיהוּא֙ לִפְנֵ֣י אֲבִיהֶ֔ם וּבָנִ֖ים לֹא־ הָי֣וּ לָהֶ֑ם וַֽיְכַהֲנ֔וּ אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְאִיתָמָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māṯ nā·ḏāḇ wa·’ă·ḇî·hū lip̄·nê ’ă·ḇî·hem ū·ḇā·nîm lō- hā·yū lā·hem way·ḵa·hă·nū ’el·‘ā·zār wə·’î·ṯā·mār
verses.literal: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father did and they had . . . no sons so Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests
verses.literalPt: E morreram Nadabe e Abiú antes de seu pai, e não tiveram filhos; e Eleazar e Itamar administravam o sacerdócio.

verses.original: וַיֶּֽחָלְקֵ֣ם דָּוִ֔יד וְצָדוֹק֙ מִן־ בְּנֵ֣י אֶלְעָזָ֔ר וַאֲחִימֶ֖לֶךְ מִן־ בְּנֵ֣י אִיתָמָ֑ר לִפְקֻדָּתָ֖ם בַּעֲבֹדָתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ye·ḥā·lə·qêm dā·wîḏ wə·ṣā·ḏō·wq min- bə·nê ’el·‘ā·zār wa·’ă·ḥî·me·leḵ min- bə·nê ’î·ṯā·mār lip̄·qud·dā·ṯām ba·‘ă·ḇō·ḏā·ṯām
verses.literal: With the help of Eleazar’s descendant Zadok and Ithamar’s descendant Ahimelech David divided them according to the offices of their service
verses.literalPt: E Davi, com Zadoque, dos filhos de Eleazar, e Aimeleque, dos filhos de Itamar, dividiu-os segundo o seu ofício no seu ministério.

verses.original: וַיִּמָּצְא֣וּ בְֽנֵי־ אֶלְעָזָ֡ר רַבִּ֞ים לְרָאשֵׁ֧י הַגְּבָרִ֛ים מִן־ בְּנֵ֥י אִיתָמָ֖ר וַֽיַּחְלְק֑וּם לִבְנֵ֨י אֶלְעָזָ֜ר רָאשִׁ֤ים לְבֵית־ אָבוֹת֙ שִׁשָּׁ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר וְלִבְנֵ֧י אִיתָמָ֛ר לְבֵ֥ית אֲבוֹתָ֖ם שְׁמוֹנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yim·mā·ṣə·’ū ḇə·nê- ’el·‘ā·zār rab·bîm lə·rā·šê hag·gə·ḇā·rîm min- bə·nê ’î·ṯā·mār way·yaḥ·lə·qūm liḇ·nê ’el·‘ā·zār rā·šîm lə·ḇêṯ- ’ā·ḇō·wṯ šiš·šāh ‘ā·śār wə·liḇ·nê ’î·ṯā·mār lə·ḇêṯ ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām šə·mō·w·nāh
verses.literal: Since more leaders . . . were found among Eleazar’s descendants than those of Ithamar they were divided accordingly There were sixteen . . . heads of families from the descendants . . . of Eleazar and eight from the descendants . . . of Ithamar
verses.literalPt: E acharam-se muito mais chefes dos pais entre os filhos de Eleazar do que entre os filhos de Itamar, quando os repartiram; dos filhos de Eleazar dezesseis chefes das casas paternas, mas dos filhos de Itamar, segundo as casas paternas, oito.

verses.original: וַיַּחְלְק֥וּם בְּגוֹרָל֖וֹת אֵ֣לֶּה עִם־ אֵ֑לֶּה כִּי־ הָי֤וּ שָֽׂרֵי־ קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ וְשָׂרֵ֣י הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים מִבְּנֵ֥י אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וּבִבְנֵ֥י אִיתָמָֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yaḥ·lə·qūm bə·ḡō·w·rā·lō·wṯ ’êl·leh ‘im- ’êl·leh kî- hā·yū śā·rê- qō·ḏeš wə·śā·rê hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm mib·bə·nê ’el·‘ā·zār ū·ḇiḇ·nê ’î·ṯā·mār
verses.literal: Thus they were divided by lot . . . . . . . . . for there were officers of the sanctuary and officers of God among both Eleazar’s . . . and Ithamar’s descendants
verses.literalPt: E os repartiram por sortes, uns com os outros; porque houve governadores do santuário e governadores da casa de Deus, assim dentre os filhos de Eleazar, como dentre os filhos de Itamar.

verses.original: וַֽיִּכְתְּבֵ֡ם שְֽׁמַֽעְיָה֩ בֶן־ נְתַנְאֵ֨ל הַסּוֹפֵ֜ר מִן־ הַלֵּוִ֗י לִפְנֵ֨י הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ וְהַשָּׂרִים֙ וְצָד֣וֹק הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וַאֲחִימֶ֙לֶךְ֙ בֶּן־ אֶבְיָתָ֔ר וְרָאשֵׁי֙ הָֽאָב֔וֹת לַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְלַלְוִיִּ֑ם בֵּֽית־ אָ֣ב אֶחָ֗ד אָחֻז֙ לְאֶלְעָזָ֔ר וְאָחֻ֥ז׀ אָחֻ֖ז לְאִיתָמָֽר׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiḵ·tə·ḇêm šə·ma‘·yāh ḇen- nə·ṯan·’êl has·sō·w·p̄êr min- hal·lê·wî lip̄·nê ham·me·leḵ wə·haś·śā·rîm wə·ṣā·ḏō·wq hak·kō·hên wa·’ă·ḥî·me·leḵ ben- ’eḇ·yā·ṯār wə·rā·šê hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ lak·kō·hă·nîm wə·lal·wî·yim bêṯ- ’āḇ ’e·ḥāḏ ’ā·ḥuz lə·’el·‘ā·zār wə·’ā·ḥuz ’ā·ḥuz lə·’î·ṯā·mār
verses.literal: The scribe . . . Shemaiah son of Nethanel a Levite recorded their names in the presence of the king and of the officers Zadok the priest Ahimelech son of Abiathar and the heads of families of the priests and the Levites one family . . . being taken from Eleazar . . . and then one from Ithamar
verses.literalPt: E Semaías, filho de Natanael, o escrivão dentre os levitas, os registrou perante o rei, e os príncipes, e Zadoque, o sacerdote, e Aimeleque, filho de Abiatar, e os chefes dos pais entre os sacerdotes, e entre os levitas; dentre as casas dos pais tomou-se uma para Eleazar, e outra para Itamar.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֞א הַגּוֹרָ֤ל הָרִאשׁוֹן֙ לִיה֣וֹיָרִ֔יב לִֽידַעְיָ֖ה הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê hag·gō·w·rāl hā·ri·šō·wn lî·hō·w·yā·rîḇ lî·ḏa‘·yāh haš·šê·nî
verses.literal: The first lot fell to Jehoiarib the second to Jedaiah
verses.literalPt: E saiu a primeira sorte a Jeoiaribe, a segunda a Jedaías,

verses.original: לְחָרִם֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י לִשְׂעֹרִ֖ים הָרְבִעִֽי׃
verses.literal: the third to Harim the fourth to Seorim
verses.literalPt: A terceira a Harim, a quarta a Seorim,

verses.original: לְמַלְכִּיָּה֙ הַחֲמִישִׁ֔י לְמִיָּמִ֖ן הַשִּׁשִּֽׁי׃
verses.literal: the fifth to Malchijah the sixth to Mijamin
verses.literalPt: A quinta a Malquias, a sexta a Miamim,

verses.original: לְהַקּוֹץ֙ הַשְּׁבִעִ֔י לַאֲבִיָּ֖ה הַשְּׁמִינִֽי׃
verses.literal: the seventh to Hakkoz the eighth to Abijah
verses.literalPt: A sétima a Hacoz, a oitava a Abias,

verses.original: לְיֵשׁ֙וּעַ֙ הַתְּשִׁעִ֔י לִשְׁכַנְיָ֖הוּ הָעֲשִׂרִֽי׃
verses.literal: the ninth to Jeshua the tenth to Shecaniah
verses.literalPt: A nona a Jesua, a décima a Secanias,

verses.original: לְאֶלְיָשִׁיב֙ עַשְׁתֵּ֣י עָשָׂ֔ר לְיָקִ֖ים שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.literal: the eleventh . . . to Eliashib the twelfth . . . to Jakim
verses.literalPt: A undécima a Eliasibe, a duodécima a Jaquim,

verses.original: לְחֻפָּה֙ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר לְיֶֽשֶׁבְאָ֖ב אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.literal: the thirteenth . . . to Huppah the fourteenth . . . to Jeshebeab
verses.literalPt: A décima terceira a Hupa, a décima quarta a Jesebeabe,

verses.original: לְבִלְגָּה֙ חֲמִשָּׁ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר לְאִמֵּ֖ר שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.literal: the fifteenth . . . to Bilgah the sixteenth . . . to Immer
verses.literalPt: A décima quinta a Bilga, a décima sexta a Imer,

verses.original: לְחֵזִיר֙ שִׁבְעָ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר לְהַפִּצֵּ֖ץ שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.literal: the seventeenth . . . to Hezir the eighteenth to Happizzez . . .
verses.literalPt: A décima sétima a Hezir, a décima oitava a Hapizes,

verses.original: לִֽפְתַחְיָה֙ תִּשְׁעָ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר לִֽיחֶזְקֵ֖אל הָעֶשְׂרִֽים׃
verses.literal: the nineteenth . . . to Pethahiah the twentieth to Jehezkel
verses.literalPt: A décima nona a Petaías, a vigésima a Jeezquel,

verses.original: לְיָכִין֙ אֶחָ֣ד וְעֶשְׂרִ֔ים לְגָמ֖וּל שְׁנַ֥יִם וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃
verses.literal: the twenty-first . . . to Jachin the twenty-second . . . to Gamul
verses.literalPt: A vigésima primeira a Jaquim, a vigésima segunda a Gamul,

verses.original: לִדְלָיָ֙הוּ֙ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֔ים לְמַֽעַזְיָ֖הוּ אַרְבָּעָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃פ
verses.literal: the twenty-third . . . to Delaiah and the twenty-fourth . . . to Maaziah
verses.literalPt: A vigésima terceira a Delaías, a vigésima quarta a Maazias.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה פְקֻדָּתָ֞ם לַעֲבֹדָתָ֗ם לָב֤וֹא לְבֵית־ יְהוָה֙ כְּמִשְׁפָּטָ֔ם בְּיַ֖ד אַהֲרֹ֣ן אֲבִיהֶ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֔הוּ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh p̄ə·qud·dā·ṯām la·‘ă·ḇō·ḏā·ṯām lā·ḇō·w lə·ḇêṯ- Yah·weh kə·miš·pā·ṭām bə·yaḏ ’a·hă·rōn ’ă·ḇî·hem ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wā·hū Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: This was their appointed order for service when they entered the house of the LORD according to the regulations prescribed for them by their forefather Aaron as the LORD the God of Israel had commanded him
verses.literalPt: O ofício destes no seu ministério era entrar na casa do SENHOR, segundo lhes fora ordenado por Arão seu pai, como o SENHOR Deus de Israel lhe tinha mandado.

verses.original: וְלִבְנֵ֥י לֵוִ֖י הַנּוֹתָרִ֑ים לִבְנֵ֤י עַמְרָם֙ שֽׁוּבָאֵ֔ל לִבְנֵ֥י שׁוּבָאֵ֖ל יֶחְדְּיָֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·liḇ·nê lê·wî han·nō·w·ṯā·rîm liḇ·nê ‘am·rām šū·ḇā·’êl liḇ·nê šū·ḇā·’êl yeḥ·də·yā·hū
verses.literal: Now these were the rest of the descendants of Levi From the sons of Amram Shubael from the sons of Shubael Jehdeiah
verses.literalPt: E do restante dos filhos de Levi: dos filhos de Anrão, Subael; dos filhos de Subael, Jedias.

verses.original: לִרְחַבְיָ֑הוּ לִבְנֵ֣י רְחַבְיָ֔הוּ הָרֹ֖אשׁ יִשִּׁיָּֽה׃
verses.literal: As for Rehabiah from his sons . . . The first was Isshiah
verses.literalPt: Quanto a Reabias: dos filhos de Reabias, Issias era o primeiro;

verses.original: לַיִּצְהָרִ֣י שְׁלֹמ֔וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י שְׁלֹמ֖וֹת יָֽחַת׃
verses.literal: From the Izharites Shelomoth from the sons of Shelomoth Jahath
verses.literalPt: Dos izaritas, Selomote; dos filhos de Selomote, Jaate;

verses.original: וּבְנָ֖י יְרִיָּ֑הוּ אֲמַרְיָ֙הוּ֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י יַחֲזִיאֵל֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י יְקַמְעָ֖ם הָרְבִיעִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nāy yə·rî·yā·hū ’ă·mar·yā·hū haš·šê·nî ya·ḥă·zî·’êl haš·šə·lî·šî yə·qam·‘ām hā·rə·ḇî·‘î
verses.literal: From the sons of Hebron Jeriah was the first Amariah the second Jahaziel the third and Jekameam the fourth
verses.literalPt: E dos filhos de Hebrom, Jerias o primeiro, Amarias o segundo, Jaaziel o terceiro, Jecameão o quarto;

verses.original: בְּנֵ֤י עֻזִּיאֵל֙ מִיכָ֔ה לִבְנֵ֥י מִיכָ֖ה שָׁמוּר׃
verses.literal: From the sons of Uzziel Micah from the sons of Micah Shamir
verses.literalPt: Dos filhos de Uziel, Mica; dos filhos de Mica, Samir;

verses.original: אֲחִ֤י מִיכָה֙ יִשִּׁיָּ֔ה לִבְנֵ֥י יִשִּׁיָּ֖ה זְכַרְיָֽהוּ׃
verses.literal: The brother of Micah Isshiah from the sons of Isshiah Zechariah
verses.literalPt: O irmão de Mica, Issias; dos filhos de Issias, Zacarias;

verses.original: בְּנֵ֤י מְרָרִי֙ מַחְלִ֣י וּמוּשִׁ֔י בְּנֵ֖י יַעֲזִיָּ֥הֽוּ בְנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê mə·rā·rî maḥ·lî ū·mū·šî bə·nê ya·‘ă·zî·yā·hū ḇə·nōw
verses.literal: The sons of Merari Mahli and Mushi The son of Jaaziah Beno
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Merari, Mali e Musi; dos filhos de Jaazias, Beno;

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י מְרָרִ֑י לְיַֽעֲזִיָּ֣הֽוּ בְנ֔וֹ וְשֹׁ֥הַם וְזַכּ֖וּר וְעִבְרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê mə·rā·rî lə·ya·‘ă·zî·yā·hū ḇə·nōw wə·šō·ham wə·zak·kūr wə·‘iḇ·rî
verses.literal: The descendants of Merari from Jaaziah Beno Shoham Zaccur and Ibri
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Merari: de Jaazias, Beno, e Soão, e Zacur, e Ibri;

verses.original: לְמַחְלִי֙ אֶלְעָזָ֔ר וְלֹא־ הָ֥יָה ל֖וֹ בָּנִֽים׃
verses.literal: From Mahli Eleazar who had no sons
verses.literalPt: De Mali, Eleazar; e este não teve filhos.

verses.original: לְקִ֖ישׁ בְּנֵי־ קִ֥ישׁ יְרַחְמְאֵֽל׃
verses.literal: From Kish Jerahmeel the son of Kish
verses.literalPt: Quanto a Quis: dos filhos de Quis, Jerameel;

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י מוּשִׁ֔י מַחְלִ֥י וְעֵ֖דֶר וִירִימ֑וֹת אֵ֛לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י הַלְוִיִּ֖ם לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê mū·šî maḥ·lî wə·‘ê·ḏer wî·rî·mō·wṯ ’êl·leh bə·nê hal·wî·yim lə·ḇêṯ ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·hem
verses.literal: And the sons of Mushi Mahli Eder and Jerimoth These were the sons of the Levites according to their families . . .
verses.literalPt: E os filhos de Musi: Mali, e Eder, e Jerimote; estes foram os filhos dos levitas, segundo as suas casas paternas.

verses.original: וַיַּפִּילוּ֩ גַם־ הֵ֨ם גּוֹרָל֜וֹת לְעֻמַּ֣ת׀ אֲחֵיהֶ֣ם בְּנֵֽי־ אַהֲרֹ֗ן לִפְנֵ֨י דָוִ֤יד הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ וְצָד֣וֹק וַאֲחִימֶ֔לֶךְ וְרָאשֵׁי֙ הָֽאָב֔וֹת לַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְלַלְוִיִּ֑ם אָב֣וֹת הָרֹ֔אשׁ לְעֻמַּ֖ת אָחִ֥יו הַקָּטָֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yap·pî·lū ḡam- hêm gō·w·rā·lō·wṯ lə·‘um·maṯ ’ă·ḥê·hem bə·nê- ’a·hă·rōn lip̄·nê ḏā·wîḏ ham·me·leḵ wə·ṣā·ḏō·wq wa·’ă·ḥî·me·leḵ wə·rā·šê hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ lak·kō·hă·nîm wə·lal·wî·yim ’ā·ḇō·wṯ hā·rōš lə·‘um·maṯ ’ā·ḥîw haq·qā·ṭān
verses.literal: As their brothers the descendants of Aaron did they also cast lots in the presence of King David and of Zadok Ahimelech and the heads of the families of the priests and Levites the family heads and their younger brothers alike
verses.literalPt: Estes também lançaram sortes como seus irmãos, os filhos de Arão, perante o rei Davi, e Zadoque, e Aimeleque, e os chefes das famílias entre os sacerdotes e entre os levitas; assim fizeram, tanto os pais principais como os irmãos menores.
